Mutated guard (out_idx >= out_features+1) is similarly never true. Both guards are dead code.

Relaxing this check to 'out_idx >= out_features + 1' has no observable effect since neither condition can ever be satisfied. The output is always 1.0f for all batch elements regardless of which guard is used.
